integrity.euler_basis: Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus of an algebraic one-parameter torus action on a complex projective variety.
integrity.exclusion_basis: Multigraded catalecticant rank is at most two on the tangential variety because it lies in the second secant variety; coordinate monomial ranks multiply across factors.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1507.06083 gives the initial submission date 2015-07-22.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: The surviving coordinate monomials are exactly the pure monomials and monomials with a one-variable tangent excitation in exactly one factor.
integrity.object_basis: The archival source explicitly studies the tangential variety of Segre--Veronese varieties for arbitrary numbers of factors.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The bibliographic record lists Mathematics Subject Classification 14N05 first and 15A69 second.

scientific_limitations: Ordinary Euler characteristic does not determine Betti numbers, singularities, degree, defining equations, or the tensor-rank stratification.
The theorem is stated over the complex numbers; no positive-characteristic or arithmetic analogue is asserted.
The fixed-point argument is short once the multigraded flattening obstruction is isolated, so an unindexed or folklore observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of every tangential Segre--Veronese variety
